mentions.name: BudgetFlow
mentions.description: A budgeting app built around interactive sankey diagrams. It includes dynamic features such as sending excess cash elsewhere or taking missing cash from another category, and supports connecting with partners or flatmates for shared budgets.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Working on a budgeting app which uses interactive sankey diagrams.

https://budgetflow.cc

It has some dynamic features like sending excess cash or taking missing cash from somewhere else, making it quite useful.

Also, you can connect with our partner or flatmates for shared budgets.
